title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The resolver stops trusting the version
summary: The import resolver decides which symbol a name refers to, and it keyed its cache on the document version. A reopened file resolved names against the previous version imports.

highlights.title: A name resolves to the right symbol
highlights.description: Reproduced with two files of the same length whose imports were swapped: asking for `Foo` returned `a.Foo` when the file said `zz.Foo`. Go to Definition, hover and auto import all read that answer.

highlights.title: The largest cache gets a ceiling
highlights.description: It kept one entry per file ever resolved: 13.8 MB retained after resolving across a real Android project of 3187 Kotlin files, more than any other cache in the extension.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Resolving from the same document twice does not read the text again, so the hover and Go to Definition path did not get slower.
This was found by listing every place that compares a document version, after the same mistake turned up three times in a row.
